description: Real shell values of $'…' spans, for decodeAnsiC (hooks/gsd-secret-read-guard.js). Each case is [raw text between $' and its closing quote, bash bytes, zsh bytes]: the hex of the argument a child process received for $'<raw>' (so cut at the first NUL), or null when the shell refused the line.
method: eval "v=\$'<raw>'" in each shell, then /bin/sh -c 'printf %s "$1"' x "$v" | od -An -tx1. Spans: 1-6 tokens drawn from literals and the escape forms each shell treats specially (seeded generator, seed 5285; 1200 of 4000 kept). The full 4000 and a second seed of 4000 agreed with decodeAnsiC for both shells when this file was written.
